meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: 网页与数字界面设计师在构建Web页面或应用组件时，若受够了千篇一律的AI味设计，请用此技能。一键生成极具视觉冲击力、排版独特、动效惊艳的生产级前端代码，告别平庸，打造令人难忘的高品质数字界面。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成排版独特、动效惊艳的生产级前端代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果受够了千篇一律的AI味网页设计
copy.tagline_en: Generate production-grade frontend code with unique typography and stunning motion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are tired of generic AI-look web designs

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先为你选定一个鲜明的美学方向(如极简、复古未来、编辑杂志等),再写出可运行的生产级前端代码,在字体、配色、动效、布局和背景细节上有意避开常见的 AI 风格。
howto.when: 当你要构建网页、组件或应用界面,并想避开千篇一律的 AI 味道设计时使用;流程是先确定美学方向,再动手写代码。

say.text: 做一个个人作品集页面,走编辑杂志风格,别用 Inter 字体
say.note: 会先定美学方向再产出代码

say.text: 把这个 React 组件重做成极简但排版有冲击力的版本
say.note: 会按你给的方向重写组件

say.text: 给落地页加动效:加载时错落出现、滚动时触发
say.note: 会加入 CSS 或 Motion 动效

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude first commits to a bold aesthetic direction (brutally minimal, retro-futuristic, editorial, etc.), then writes working production-grade frontend code (HTML/CSS/JS, React, Vue) that deliberately avoids generic AI-looking fonts, colors, layouts and effects.
howto.when_en: Use it when you are building a webpage, component, or app interface and want to avoid generic AI-flavored design. The flow: pick an aesthetic direction first, then write the code.

say_en.text: Build a personal portfolio page in an editorial magazine style; no Inter font
say_en.note: It picks a direction, then codes

say_en.text: Rework this React component into a minimal but typographically bold version
say_en.note: It rewrites the component your way

say_en.text: Add motion to this landing page: staggered load, scroll-triggered reveals
say_en.note: It adds CSS or Motion effects
